extension.summary: Installs and updates the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Repository for the MediaHub streaming-style skin for movies and TV shows. Install the skin from Install from repository - MediaHub Repository - Look and feel - Skin, and it will be kept up to date automatically.

extension.summary: A streaming-app style skin for movies and TV shows
extension.description: MediaHub turns your Kodi movie and TV library into a modern streaming app: a rotating hero slider, network cards (Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, National Geographic, Star and 30+ more) that open a hub for that studio or network, and home rows you choose and reorder. Add titles to My List, rate them with thumbs up / down / love for better recommendations, and find more with More Like This, actor pages and a live search page. TV shows get a Disney+-style page with season tabs and movie collections get their own page, Up Next picks up where you left off, and NEW and 4K badges show what's new and in 4K. The player bar shows the title's clearart or logo with 4K, HDR, Dolby and 5.1 badges, with an Audio & Subtitles panel, a pause screen and Skip Intro / Recap / Credits buttons. There are also music screens with a now playing page, a Live TV guide, a screensaver made from your library, a "Who's watching?" profile screen, a Kids mode with a PIN and a bedtime, a shared Family List, backup and restore, large text and high contrast, and seven accent colours.
extension.disclaimer: The network card artwork is plain typography. Studio and network names are trademarks of their respective owners.

extension.summary: Up Next, My List, thumbs and recommendations for the MediaHub skin
extension.description: Runs in the background for the MediaHub skin. It works out Up Next (the next episode of every TV show you are part-way through, with the following episodes queued when you play one), keeps My List, stores your thumbs up / down as the library's own "my rating", and ranks Recommended For You and More Like This from them. It also fills in collection pages, works out the NEW badges, lists the audio and subtitle tracks for the player's Audio & Subtitles panel, runs the start-up intro and the MediaHub screensaver, plays trailer previews in the home rows, keeps Finish by, intro memory and the sound modes going while you watch, finds people when you search, picks a Surprise, works out Your year, downloads titles to watch offline and checks for MediaHub updates. It also reads an IPTV playlist for the On demand pages, keeps My Channels, looks up upcoming episodes on TVmaze for the Calendar, turns Lite mode on when memory runs low, and checks the library's health. If Kodi ever closes on its own, it says where that happened and offers Safe mode.

extension.summary: Your Xtream Codes IPTV service: live TV, catch-up, films and series
extension.description: Sign in with the server address, username and password your IPTV provider gave you. Live TV by category with what's on now and next, catch-up for channels that have it, and films and series with the service's own posters and plots. Films and episodes resume where you stopped, the next episode is queued, and Search finds channels, films and series. Made for the MediaHub skin (side menu, home rows), and works with any skin. Only use a service you are licensed to watch.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on does not provide any channels, films or series: it plays what your own IPTV service offers you.

extension.summary: Thousands of internet radio stations from around the world
extension.description: Listen to internet radio stations from radio-browser.info, a free, community-run list with no account needed: what's popular in your country, the most listened and most voted stations, and every station by genre, country or language, with search. Add the ones you like to Your stations, and wake up to one with the alarm clock (it fades in, and turns the TV on where it can). Made for the MediaHub skin (side menu, home rows), and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: Stations are listed by radio-browser.info and streamed by their broadcasters; MediaHub doesn't host or check them.
extension.news: 1.1.0 - An alarm clock: wake up to a station, fading in, with snooze. 1.0.0 - First release: Your stations, Recently played, Popular in your country, Most listened, Most voted, Listened to right now, genres, countries, languages and search.

extension.summary: Find, follow and listen to podcasts
extension.description: Search every podcast in Apple's podcast directory (no account needed), see the top podcasts in your country, or add any podcast by its feed address. Follow the ones you like: their new episodes appear in Latest episodes, episodes resume where you stopped and get a tick once played, and you're told when a new one comes out. Made for the MediaHub skin (side menu, home rows), and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: Podcasts are found with Apple's podcast search and played straight from their publishers' feeds.
extension.news: 1.1.1 - Its Continue cards say when you last played them, for MediaHub's Continue Anywhere row. 1.1.0 - Download episodes (they play from the file), a Downloads page, and download new episodes of a podcast automatically. 1.0.0 - First release: Latest episodes, Continue listening, Your podcasts, Top podcasts, search, any podcast by its feed address, resume and played ticks, and a message when a new episode comes out.

extension.summary: Use your phone's web browser as Kodi's remote
extension.description: Scan the QR code from Connect a phone (or open the address it shows) in your phone's browser: nothing to install. A remote with a touch pad, what's playing with its picture and a seek bar, volume, typing on the TV, search across your films, shows and IPTV, your IPTV channels and radio stations to start with one tap, Send to TV (a YouTube or video link, or photos and videos from your phone) and MediaHub's Movie quiz night on your phone. Each phone is paired once with a code the TV shows. Made for the MediaHub skin, and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: The remote works on your home network only. Anyone who wants to use it needs the code shown on the TV.

extension.summary: Keep what you've watched and your lists the same on every Kodi
extension.description: Pick a folder every Kodi in the house can reach (a network share, a NAS, or a folder a cloud drive keeps in step) and MediaHub Sync keeps them in step: what you've watched and where you stopped, your thumbs and My List (films and shows are matched by their IMDb or TMDB id, so the libraries don't have to be the same), MediaHub's Family List, MediaHub IPTV's progress, channels, My List and reminders, MediaHub Radio's stations and MediaHub Podcasts' podcasts and progress. Each Kodi writes only its own file, and the latest change wins. Stop a film or episode on one Kodi and MediaHub's home screen offers to carry on from there on another. Made for MediaHub, and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: Nothing leaves your folder: there's no MediaHub account or server.
extension.news: 1.3.0 - Reactions sent from the phones in one room show up in the other while you watch together. 1.2.0 - Watch together: two Kodis in the house play the same film or episode in step, and a pause, a play or a skip on one does the same on the other. 1.1.0 - Carry on watching: stop a film or episode on one Kodi and MediaHub offers to carry on from there on the next. 1.0.0 - First release: watched, resume points, thumbs and My List, the Family List, and MediaHub IPTV, Radio and Podcasts, through a shared folder.

extension.summary: Bring your IMDb and Letterboxd lists and ratings into Kodi
extension.description: Export your ratings, watchlist or lists from IMDb (a .csv) or everything from Letterboxd (a .zip), and MediaHub Import finds the films and shows you have in your library: your watchlist goes into My List, your ratings become thumbs (love, up or down), and what you've rated or watched is marked as watched. It ends with what was found and what isn't in your library. Made for the MediaHub skin, and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: It only reads the file you choose: nothing is sent anywhere.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First release: IMDb ratings, watchlist and lists; Letterboxd's watched films, ratings, watchlist and likes.

extension.summary: What's on at the cinema and coming soon, with trailers
extension.description: The films showing at cinemas in your country and the ones coming soon, from TMDB, with their posters, trailers (with the YouTube add-on) and what they're about. Choose "Tell me when it's out at home" on any film and it lets you know when you can buy or rent it, or when it turns up in your library. It needs a free TMDB API key (themoviedb.org), which MediaHub can share with On demand. Made for the MediaHub skin (Cinema: Now Showing and Cinema: Coming Soon home rows), and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: Film details and pictures come from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. Cinema times near you aren't included: there's no free, open listing of them.
extension.news: 1.1.0 - Where to watch: the streaming services that have a film in your country (from JustWatch, through TMDB). 1.0.0 - First release: Now showing, Coming soon, search, trailers, and Tell me when it's out at home.

extension.description: Thousands of free audiobooks: classics that are out of copyright, read by LibriVox's volunteers. Browse the most popular and the newest, by genre, or search by title or author. A book plays chapter after chapter and carries on where you stopped, next time too (Continue listening). Keep the ones you want in My books. The recordings come from the Internet Archive; no account needed. Made for the MediaHub skin (the Audiobooks: Continue Listening home row), and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: LibriVox recordings are in the public domain in the USA; check the copyright where you live. MediaHub isn't part of LibriVox or the Internet Archive.
extension.news: 1.0.1 - Its Continue cards say when you last played them, for MediaHub's Continue Anywhere row. 1.0.0 - First release: popular, newest, genres, search, My books, chapters and Continue listening.

extension.summary: Old films and TV, free to watch
extension.description: Thousands of films and TV episodes that are free to watch because they're out of copyright, from the Internet Archive: feature films, film noir, science fiction and horror, comedies, westerns, silent films, cartoons and classic TV. Most watched first, with search, My List, and Continue watching: a film resumes where you stopped. No account needed. Made for the MediaHub skin (the Classics: Continue Watching and Classic Films home rows), and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: The films come from the Internet Archive's public-domain collections; check the copyright where you live. MediaHub isn't part of the Internet Archive.
extension.news: 1.0.1 - Its Continue cards say when you last played them, for MediaHub's Continue Anywhere row. 1.0.0 - First release: eight kinds of classics, search, My List and Continue watching.

The MediaHub skin shows it on the home screen, on its Weather page and on the clock screensaver; it works with any skin.

extension.summary: Fixtures, results and league tables for your teams
extension.description: Your teams' next matches, latest results and league tables, in any sport TheSportsDB knows (football, rugby, basketball, ice hockey, American football, cricket and more). On match days a notification says when your team kicks off and the final score. Made for the MediaHub skin: a Scores: Your Teams home row. Works with any skin. It's scores only: there's no free, legal stream of the matches to watch.
extension.disclaimer: Fixtures, results and tables come from TheSportsDB (thesportsdb.com), made by its community. MediaHub isn't part of it or of any league.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First release: your teams, fixtures, results, tables, kick-off and full-time notifications.

extension.summary: The headlines from the news sites you choose
extension.description: Headlines from the news sites you choose (BBC News, The Guardian, NPR, Al Jazeera, DW, France 24, CBC, ABC, tagesschau, El País, Le Monde, ANSA, g1 and more), or any site's news feed: top stories from all of them, newest first, with their pictures and a few lines each, and the news bulletins some of them keep as podcasts or videos, which play. extension.disclaimer: The stories come from the news sites' own public feeds and belong to them. MediaHub isn't part of any of them.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First release: top stories, each site, bulletins, and your own feeds.

extension.summary: NASA's picture of the day, NASA live and where the space station is
extension.description: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day: a picture of space every day, full screen, with an astronomer's explanation; the last few weeks, and a surprise one from the archive going back to 1995. NASA live (with the YouTube add-on), and where the International Space Station is right now. No account needed (a free NASA key can go in the settings). Made for the MediaHub skin: a Space: Picture of the Day home row, and today's picture as MediaHub's background or screensaver. Works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: The pictures and their words come from NASA's APOD (apod.nasa.gov); some are copyrighted by their photographers. The space station's position comes from wheretheiss.at. MediaHub isn't part of NASA.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First release: the picture of the day, the last few weeks, a surprise one, NASA live and where the ISS is.

extension.summary: Something to cook tonight, with Cook along
extension.description: Hundreds of recipes from TheMealDB: the recipe of the day, Surprise me, recipes by kind (beef, chicken, pasta, vegetarian, desserts...) and by country, and search. Each recipe shows its ingredients and method, and most have a video. Cook along shows one big step at a time that you can read from across the kitchen, with a timer when a step says how long, and keeps the screen saver away. Save the ones you like. No account needed. Made for the MediaHub skin, and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: The recipes come from TheMealDB (themealdb.com); the videos need the YouTube add-on. MediaHub isn't part of TheMealDB.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First release: recipes by kind and country, search, Saved recipes and Cook along.

extension.summary: Live concerts, free to listen to
extension.description: Hundreds of thousands of live shows from the Internet Archive's Live Music Archive, recorded by fans of bands who allow taping and sharing: the most played shows, bands (most played first, or search) with their shows year by year, and every show from any year. Each show lists its setlist, the date and the venue; play it all or from any song, and it carries on where you stopped. Continue listening and My shows. No account needed. Made for the MediaHub skin (the Concerts: Continue Listening home row), and works with any skin.
extension.disclaimer: The recordings come from the Internet Archive's Live Music Archive, shared with the bands' permission for non-commercial listening. MediaHub isn't part of the Internet Archive.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First release: bands, years, the most played shows, setlists, My shows and Continue listening.

extension.summary: Rain, waves, a fire and calm noise to fall asleep to
extension.description: Calm sounds that play for as long as you like: rain, a thunderstorm, ocean waves, a crackling fire, and white, pink or brown noise. A sleep timer fades the sound out and stops it, and a dim screen moves slowly while it plays: rain falling, waves rolling, a fire's glow. The sounds are made, not recorded, and come with the add-on, so it all works with no internet. Made for the MediaHub skin, and works with any skin.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - First release: seven sounds, a sleep timer and the relax screen.
